beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Fundamental analysis determines what asset to select, but technical analysis dictates exact execution timing.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Technical analysis measures instantaneous supply and demand, managing defined stops and risk/reward.

beatOutlines.textOutline: When fundamentally solid balance sheets meet technical breakout setups, the highest conviction trades emerge.
